start.description: On September 10, 2026 I called the city code enforcement about the broken smoke detectors and the mold in my apartment, because my landlord never fixed them. On September 24, 2026 my landlord handed me a 7-day notice saying I'm violating the lease by having a cat and I have 7 days to remove it or the lease ends. I've had the cat for a year and he never cared before. The smoke detectors and the mold have been like that since September 1, 2026, and the landlord has done nothing about them. I have kept paying rent. I have not sent him anything in writing about them, nothing anyone did caused them that I know of, and no court papers have come. I never got a written warning before the 7-day notice, I still have the cat, and the landlord has not taken any rent from me since.

chat: Is he doing this because I reported him to the city?
Has a court ever said a landlord can't go after you for reporting them?
